title: ::: K-IG 교육 영어듣기훈련프로그램 | 기초2 | 제 001 회 강의 :::
label: [ K-IG 교육 Reading 056 ]

blocks.text: The young should learn that no one can win all the time and that it's possible to enjoy a game even when they don't win. A child who doesn't make the baseball team feels terrible. But parents should not offer a quick prize or say, "It doesn't matter," because it does. The youngster should be allowed to experience disappointment.
③ delight ③ praises ⑤ patriotism
